observed_outcome: Registered fixture sources run automatic startup/interval/debounced-watcher scans and manual scans through TaskService (`ppm.inventory.scan`) under a DB lease + monotonically increasing `fencing_token` across `ppm_scan_schedules` and `leases`. Redelivered `occurrence_id` executes once (`duplicate_occurrence`). Two racing schedulers execute at most one scan (`lease_busy`), and an overtaken worker with a stale fencing token cannot commit a snapshot (`StaleFencingTokenError`). Rescans of unchanged data compute identical semantic `inputs_hash` (`ISS-034`), creating 0 new assessments and 0 new notes/updates/artifacts rows while updating `last_successful_scan_at`. Clock jump past 12 intervals runs a single catch-up scan. `PPM_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false` blocks automatic triggers while preserving manual scans. ISS-028 root replacement / runtime failure records redacted `last_error`, creates 0 assessments, and advances `next_due_at` without a tight retry loop.
